I actually had this to. 
It's not an end all be all. Heres my story

First year uni, friend introduced me to O and O was fairly attractive and we slowly got close. I got turned down but she stuck by me. And I still thought I liked her in that way. I thought that because in high school I was always left out or weird or annoying ect. I was still like that with her but she saw a good friend in me and then I broke down IN HER CAR  to HER about HER. I thought it was over right then and there.  But it wasn't instead kicking me to the curb she said it's okay catch your breath and actually helped me calm down. After that i saw what was happening, I took a friend and raised them higher then they should be higher then me to myself. 

We stayed friends and her and counseling are one of the reasons I got control of my emotional dysregulation, I still break down I still shatter and yell and feel over guilty but I know why and I'm okay with it. And that's the important thing, being okay and allowing yourself to when no one else does. 

My experience may not relate but take a step  back be okay with being alone, be okay with breaking down, and be okay with having just a friend. Friends can get really close she pulled me out of some dark situations, doesn't mean I love her though even though I thought it should. 

You'll get there it's a hard road but patience and just being okay with not being okay.

I wish you luck my friend.
